scope.content: All12indexpages, printed903–914, and4unnumbered Graduate Texts in Mathematics catalogue pages containing volumes1–224.
scope.method: Personally viewed every original full-page PNG via view_image and read complete EN and ZH manuscripts; compared every index main entry and child, printed page number/range/Roman numeral, original alphabetic and column order, cross-column/cross-page continuations, Chinese translation with English labels; compared all224catalogue authors, full titles/subtitles, parts/volumes/editions and series qualifiers. Automated hierarchy/page-number and catalogue-ID checks supplement, and do not replace, direct visual comparison.

pageChecks.scope: All two-column index entries abc conjecture through bilinear form; abelian/algebraic/alternating/associated and belong nested subitems, page numbers and Chinese-English matching, original order retained.

All two-column index entries bilinear map through connection; Bourbaki/Burnside/Cauchy/center/character/cocycle/coefficient/commutative/commutator/compact/complete/conjugate subitems, Roman ix and GL_n/SL_n notation, page numbers and bilingual matching.

All two-column index entries constant polynomial through dual representation, including coproduct/cycle/cyclic/degree/determinant/dimension/direct/distinguished and dual subitems; printed unusual of-rings page order335,291 retained, full bilingual labels and page numbers.

All entries effective character through Fourier coefficients; elementary/elimination/embedding/enough/equivalent/exponent/extension cross-column/exterior/factor/finite/finitely generated/fixed/flat/form subitems, ranges and literal printed entire-functions87, bilingual matching.

All free through homomorphism entries, all nested free/Frobenius/Galois/generate/generic/graded/Grothendieck/group/hermitian/Hilbert/homogeneous/homology items; GL2/GLn notation, cross-column sequence and page ranges, full Chinese-English labels.

Homomorphism continued and all entries through Jordan canonical form; injective children carried to top of right column; independent/induced/infinite/integral/two invariant heads/inverse/irreducible subitems, Irr(z,k,X), all pages and Chinese-English matching.

All K-family through natural transformation entries; local head continues into right column norm/parameter/ring/uniformization; kernel/Krull/Kummer/least/left/length/linear/matrix/maximal/module/monoid/morphism/multiplicative/multiplicity subitems, all pages and bilingual labels.

All negative through primary module entries; Noetherian/norm/normal/null/one-dimensional/operate/orbit/order/orthogonal and p-adic/p-family/partition/point/polynomial/positive/power-series/primary subitems; cross-column continuation, page ranges and bilingual labels.

All prime through right exact-functor entries; radical head continues across columns of ring/of integer, primitive/principal/product/projective/quadratic/quotient/rational/real/reduction/regular/representation/residue/resultant/right subitems, pages and bilingual labels.

Right continued through substituting; ring/root/row/Schanuel/Schur/semisimple/separable/Serre/simple/SL2/solvable/spectral/square/stably free/standard subitems; SL_n/S3/S4 expressions and page ranges, full bilingual matching.

All super through variation-of-signs entries; super/symmetric/symplectic/Tate/tensor/Tor/torsion/total/tower/trace/transcendence/transpose/trigonometric/trivial/type/unimodular/unit/universal/universally/valuation-ring children; all page numbers, ranges and bilingual labels.
All final index entries variety through Zorn's lemma, Weierstrass/Witt/zero nested children, Roman x, page numbers and bilingual matching; original left-column then right-column order retained.

GTM entries1–63: every author grouping, complete title/subtitle, volume/part and edition; C*-algebras and p-adic notation; Chinese translation plus original title, original left-column1–33/right-column34–63 order.

GTM entries64–123: all author groupings, titles/subtitles, volumes/parts, edition qualifiers and Readings in Mathematics addenda122–123; SL2(R), Teichmüller/Brønsted/Bröcker typography, full Chinese and original title matching.
GTM entries124–182, every author/title/subtitle/part/edition and Readings in Mathematics129; Gröbner/Erdélyi and Algebraic K-Theory notation, full Chinese translations plus original titles.
